questions.prompt: Mbese uri he? Sini mu mwobo, ndi hano.
questions.answer: Where are you? I'm not in the pit, I'm here.

questions.prompt: Sinshaka guhinga none. Imuhira mfite imirimo myinshi.
questions.answer: I don't want to hoe today. I have much work at home.

questions.prompt: Mu nzu ntiharimo abantu benshi. Ntibakwiriye kugenda ubu
questions.answer: There are not many people in the house. They must not go now.

questions.prompt: Mbese ntushaka kubiba imbuto none? Oya, sinshaka kuzibiba ubu
questions.answer: Don't you want to sow the seeds today? No, I don't want to sow them now.

questions.prompt: Mu nzu yabo harimo umwijima mwinshi. Sinkunda umwijima, nawe ntuwukunda.
questions.answer: In their house there is much darkness. I don't like darkness and you don't like it.

questions.prompt: Hano hariko bake, hariya hariho benshi. Mbese, ntidukwiriye kubafasha bose?
questions.answer: Here there are a few (people); over there, there are many. Shouldn't we help them all?

questions.prompt: Mbese imbuto ze ziri he? Ntiziri mu murima we. Ndajya kuzishaka.
questions.answer: Where are his seeds? They are not in his garden. I'm going to find them.

questions.prompt: Bariya basaza benshi ntibazi guhinga. Ndajya kubafasha.
questions.answer: Those many old men don't know how to hoe. I am going to help them.

questions.prompt: Ziriya nka ziri mu murima wanjye. S'umurima wawe.
questions.answer: Those cows are in my garden. It's not your garden.

questions.prompt: Inka nyinshi ziri hano; inkeya ziri hariya. Mbese, ntuzireba zose?
questions.answer: Many cows are here; a few are over there. Don't you see them all?

questions.prompt: Hano hariho inka nkeya; hariya hariho nyinshi. Dukwiriye kuzizana?
questions.answer: Here there are a few cows; over there, there are many. We must bring them.

questions.prompt: Sinshaka iyi mitsima; ndashaka iriya. Ukwiriye kuzana imitsima yose.
questions.answer: I don't want these loaves of bread; I want those. You must bring them all.

questions.prompt: Zikwiriye kuva mu murima ubu ngubu. Ntizikwiriye kugaruka.
questions.answer: They must get out of the garden right now. They must not come back.

questions.prompt: Nkwiriye kugenda ubu. Singaruka none. Na bariya ntibagaruka none.
questions.answer: I must go now. I won't return today. And those (people) won't come back today.

questions.prompt: Humura, inka ntizigenda; abantu ntibazi aho ziri.
questions.answer: Don't worry/be comforted; the cows are not going. People don't know where they are.

questions.prompt: Mbese ingoma y'umwigisha wacu iri hano? Oya, ntiri hano, iri hariya
questions.answer: Is our teacher's drum here? No, it is not here; it is over there.

questions.prompt: Mbese, Imana iri he? Baravuga yuko iba mu muima y'abantu.
questions.answer: Where is God? They are saying that He is in the hearts of people.

questions.prompt: Mbese arajya he? Simbizi. Mbese arabizi? Ntakwiriye kugaruka ubu.
questions.answer: Where's he going? I don't know. Does he know? He must not come back now.

questions.prompt: Mbese inzu yawe nshya iri hariya? Oya, inzu yanjye ntiri hariya. Iriya n'iya Petero.
questions.answer: Is your new house over there? No, my house is not over there; that one over there is Peter's.

questions.prompt: Mbese muri hehe? Turi mu nzu ya Petero. Iyi nzu n'iya Petero.
questions.answer: Where are you? We are in Peter's house. This house is Peter's.

questions.prompt: Ntituri abana; turi abantu bakuru.
questions.answer: We are not children; we are grown people.

questions.prompt: Sindi mu muhanda. Simva mu nzu ubu. Singenda none. Ntidukwiriye kugenda none.
questions.answer: I am not in the road. I'm not coming out of the house now. I'm not going today. We must not go today.

questions.prompt: Mbese impumyi iri he? Iri iwazo. N'imfunya na zo ziri iwazo.
questions.answer: Where is the blind child? He/she is at their home. And the stunted (children) are also at their home.

questions.prompt: Abantu bakuru bose bari iwabo.
questions.answer: All the important people are at their homes.
